message.content:
In a standard Texas Hold’em game the most hearts a single player can hold is **seven** (two hole cards plus the five community cards).  
So the player who ends up with a **seven‑card flush** (or the highest‑ranking flush if more than one player has a flush) will have the highest number of hearts in that hand.  

If you’re thinking of a different poker variant (e.g., Five‑Card Draw, Seven‑Card Stud, etc.), the maximum hearts a player can have will change accordingly—five in a 5‑card hand, seven in a 7‑card hand, and so on. Let me know if you had a particular game or scenario in mind!
